statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring study) is indicated
The service is indicated to correlate symptoms with potential arrhythmic events and evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
